_status: ASSUMPTIONS, not regulation. Placeholder norms for estimating generation from mapped buildings. Calibrate with a ward waste characterisation survey, BBMP/GBA weighbridge data and CPCB BWG norms once issued (SWM Rules 2026, r. 6(e)).

household._sources: kg/capita and persons/dwelling are typical Bengaluru metro estimates.

non_residential._unit: kg per day per 100 m2 of floor area

mixed_use._rule: Ground floor treated as the commercial use found inside the building; upper floors as residential dwellings.

stream_shares._note: Share of each building's waste by stream (wet, dry, sanitary, special care). Rows sum to 1.

dry_waste_fractions._note: Assumed split of dry waste into fractions for MRF sorting. SWM Rules 2026 r. 3(1)(zw) names paper including paperboard, plastic, metal, glass etc.; wood and rubber are also sorted at MRFs. 'other_and_rejects' covers textiles, multi-layer packaging and inert rejects.

per_unit._note: Typology rates per surveyed unit, kg/day. Used when a surveyor records the number of units. Residential units use the household norm. Replace with weighed data when available.

surveyed_use._note: How a surveyor's building use maps to a typology when OSM does not already give a finer one.

_water: Water use is not estimated. The BWG water criterion (40,000 L/day) is checked only against surveyor input or BWSSB billing data.

use_mix._status: ASSUMPTIONS for Round 1 use-mix rows, not regulation and not from a cited source. Quantity per row = count x kg_per_unit, or beds_total x kg_per_bed, or (for homes) occupants_total (else count x persons_per_dwelling) x kg_per_capita_per_day. Stream shares use the named typology in stream_shares.
use_mix._calibration: Round 3 (weighed sample) calibrates this by weighing each stream for several days at a stratified sample of buildings with this use and fitting kg/day per unit or bed.

pg_coliving.note: Assumed: residents eat some meals outside, so below the 0.5 kg/capita household norm. kg_per_unit is used when beds are not recorded (assumed 10 beds).

hostel.note: Assumed: hostels with a mess cook on site. kg_per_unit is used when beds are not recorded (assumed 30 beds).

hotel_guesthouse.note: Assumed; equals the earlier per-room hotel rate (per_unit.hotel). kg_per_unit is used when beds are not recorded (assumed 20 beds).

clinic_healthcare.note: Same as per_unit.healthcare. General solid waste only; bio-medical waste is outside municipal collection.

educational.note: Assumed per school, college or coaching centre in the building. Highly variable with enrolment; Round 2 should record student numbers.

religious.note: Assumed per place of worship; festival peaks are not included.

workshop_industrial.note: Assumed per workshop; process waste that is not municipal solid waste is excluded.

institutional.note: Assumed per office of a government or community body.

vacant.note: Vacant units generate no regular waste.

under_construction.note: C&D waste is handled under the C&D Waste Management Rules, 2025, not municipal collection.

building_use_typology._status: ASSUMPTION. When a building has a surveyed building use but no use-mix rows, its waste is estimated from this OSM typology with the footprint and floors. Round 3 (weighed sample) calibrates this by weighing each stream for several days at a stratified sample of buildings with this building use and fitting kg/day per unit or bed.

gvp._note: ESTIMATE. Turns a garbage vulnerable point observation (amount each time it builds up, and how often) into kg per day for route planning. Replace with weighed pickups when collected.
gvp._size_note: ESTIMATE. Kg for the public's size choice: small (a few bags), medium (a pile about a handcart load), large (a heap needing a vehicle). Surveyors enter kg directly.
